group_assessment.weighting: A urology and pathology group using WWOX as a tumour suppressor in a rat bladder cancer line; no neurological, developmental or biallelic-LoF disease work. Observation (what was stained or counted) is weighted above interpretation (ROS-dependent senescence, tumour suppression through senescence), which rests on one unquantified rescue panel and one tissue comparison between unlike compartments.

entries.proposition: System: AY-27 rat bladder carcinoma cells (a gift line), not a neural cell or a WWOX-null background.
entries.snippet: The rat bladder cancer cell line AY-27 (a kind gift from Professor R. Moore

entries.proposition: Manipulation is lentiviral WWOX overexpression (LV-WWOX), about 2-fold over empty vector by Western blot; there is no knockdown, knockout or loss-of-function arm.
entries.snippet: was 2.01-fold (p < 0.01) higher than those in the AY-27 cells infected with the lentivirus-containing control vector (LV)
entries.anchor: 2.1 Establishment of Cell Lines Overexpressing WWOX

entries.proposition: ROS readout: DHE-positive area was reported 6.93-fold over uninfected control and 2.87-fold over empty vector after LV-WWOX.
entries.snippet: the ROS expression levels in those AY-27 cells infected with LV-WWOX were 6.93-fold (p < 0.001) higher than the control
entries.anchor: 2.3 Overexpression of WWOX Increased the TNF and ROS Activity

entries.proposition: The ROS method is one DHE fluorescence stain read as positive area; no mitochondrial probe, no oxygen consumption, no scavenger control is described.
entries.snippet: the cells were pretreated with interventions and then loaded with DHE (100 μM; Sigma

entries.proposition: Senescence readout: SA-beta-gal positive cells were 6.90-fold over uninfected control and 3.31-fold over empty vector after LV-WWOX.
entries.snippet: the senescence expression levels in the AY-27 cells infected with LV-WWOX were 6.90-fold (p < 0.001) higher than the control
entries.anchor: 2.4 WWOX Induced Premature Senescence in the Bladder Cancer Cells

experimental_context.system: AY-27 rat bladder carcinoma cells in vitro

entries.proposition: ROS-dependence of senescence rests on exendin-4 treatment described as reducing ROS; ROS under exendin-4 is not reported in the Results.
entries.snippet: Exendin-4 suppressed the WWOX-induced senescence in LV-WWOX group of AY-27 cells in comparison with Figure 4a.
entries.anchor: 2.4 WWOX Induced Premature Senescence in the Bladder Cancer Cells

experimental_context.system: AY-27 rat bladder carcinoma cells in vitro

entries.proposition: Figure 4c shows one unquantified micrograph per condition under exendin-4; the LV-WWOX panel shows faint, diffuse blue staining of a cell cluster, and there is no count, no bar chart and no ROS readout beside it; it therefore illustrates but does not quantify the claimed rescue.
entries.snippet: [figure attestation - pixels cannot be quote-matched] Figure 4c (Control, LV, LV-WWOX, all under exendin-4): three single micrographs at higher magnification than panel 4a; the LV-WWOX panel shows a cluster of cells with pale blue-green cytoplasm; no scale bar, no percentage, no n, and Figure 4b carries the only quantification (without exendin-4).

experimental_context.system: AY-27 rat bladder carcinoma cells in vitro

entries.proposition: Tumour comparison text: the control and empty-vector groups are said to have decreased tumour size by 30.49 and 28.60 percent relative to LV-WWOX, a sentence whose direction and base are unclear.
entries.snippet: compared to LV-WWOX, the control and LV also significantly decreased the tumor size by 30.49 and 28.60%, respectively (p < 0.05)
entries.anchor: 2.5 WWOX Suppressed Bladder Cancer Growth in the F344/AY-27 Rat Model

experimental_context.system: F344 rat orthotopic AY-27 bladder tumour, day 14

entries.proposition: Figure 5b: bar heights read by eye are about 12.3 (control), 13.1 (LV) and 3.7 (LV-WWOX) mm3; the LV-WWOX bar is about 30 percent of the control bar and about 28 percent of the LV bar, so 30.49 and 28.60 appear to be LV-WWOX as a percentage of the comparator, a reduction of roughly 70 percent, not 30 percent. Inference from approximate bar heights; the bar values are not tabulated and no n per group is given.
entries.snippet: [figure attestation - pixels cannot be quote-matched] Figure 5b: bar chart, y axis Tumor volume (mm3) 0 to 18; three bars with error bars, Control about 12.3, LV about 13.1, LV-WWOX about 3.7, asterisk and hash on the LV-WWOX bar; Figure 5a: three excised specimens on mm grid paper, LV-WWOX a small pale nodule; no n per group in the legend or the text.

experimental_context.system: F344 rat orthotopic AY-27 bladder tumour, day 14

entries.qualifies_needle: decreased the tumor size by 30.49 and 28.60%

entries.proposition: p21 IHC text: p21 said to be highly expressed in the LV-WWOX group versus control and LV.
entries.snippet: p21 was highly expressed in the LV-WWOX group compared to the control and LV group (Figure 5d).
entries.anchor: 2.5 WWOX Suppressed Bladder Cancer Growth in the F344/AY-27 Rat Model

experimental_context.system: F344 rat orthotopic AY-27 bladder tissue, day 14

entries.proposition: Figure 5d compares unlike compartments: the control and LV fields are solid sheets of tumour cells, whereas the LV-WWOX field is a folded urothelial epithelium over connective tissue with strong brown signal in the epithelium; there is no quantification, so the panel does not show p21 rising in tumour cells.
entries.snippet: [figure attestation - pixels cannot be quote-matched] Figure 5d (p21 IHC, Control, LV, LV-WWOX, scale bars 100 um): Control and LV show dense pleomorphic tumour cell sheets with weak pale brown signal; LV-WWOX shows a thick folded epithelial layer with intense dark brown signal above pale connective tissue; no score, count or chart accompanies the panel.

experimental_context.system: F344 rat orthotopic AY-27 bladder tissue, day 14

entries.qualifies_needle: p21 was highly expressed in the LV-WWOX group

entries.proposition: Statistics: group comparisons are run with Student's t-test and one-way ANOVA, with no named post-hoc correction or n for animals.
entries.snippet: The data were analyzed using the Student's t-test and one-way analysis of variance (ANOVA).

entries.proposition: The only mitochondrial statement is a restatement that WWOX may circumvent mitochondrial damage-induced glycolysis, sourced to an earlier Drosophila paper; this paper measures no mitochondrial quantity.
entries.snippet: (Warburg effect) has been proposed as a possible mechanism for its tumor-suppressor activity

entries.proposition: The Methods carry an epirubicin-hydrogel cytotoxicity assay that is not reported in the Results, a trace of text reused from another study of the group.
entries.snippet: then treated with epirubicin-loaded hydrogels for 18 h

entries.proposition: The authors themselves summarise the effect as cytotoxicity plus senescence, which the sparse rounded cell clusters of Figure 2a are compatible with.
entries.snippet: In conclusion, WWOX caused cytotoxicity and the induction of senescence in the AY-27 bladder cancer cells.

entries.proposition: Figure 2a shows the LV-WWOX culture as a sparse field of rounded cell clusters on a clear background, not a flat confluent layer of enlarged cells.
entries.snippet: [figure attestation - pixels cannot be quote-matched] Figure 2a (phase contrast, Control, LV, LV-WWOX, scale bar bottom right): Control and LV are confluent monolayers; LV-WWOX shows scattered round refractile cell clusters with large empty areas.
